name: Rejected Status Reason 12 Code
definition: Specifies the reason for a transfer or settlement instruction rejected status.

BLCA.name: Account Blocked For Corporate Action
BLCA.definition: Investment account is blocked due to a corporate action.

DOCC.name: Account Blocked Missing Documents
DOCC.definition: Investment account is blocked until certain legal proceedings are completed, for example, legal documents from the successor, legal proceedings due to bankruptcy.

IAQD.name: Acquisition Date
IAQD.definition: Acquisition date is not recognised or is invalid.

ICTN.name: Certificate Number
ICTN.definition: Certificate number is not recognised or is invalid.

CYPA.name: Current Year Partial
CYPA.definition: Partial transfer of current year is not allowed, that is, it is not possible to transfer one asset for the current year as other assets are held for the current year.

TREF.name: Duplicate Transfer Reference
TREF.definition: Transfer reference is a duplicate of a previously received transfer.

DSEC.name: Financial Instrument Identification
DSEC.definition: Identification of the security is not recognised or is invalid.

IDNA.name: Financial Instrument Identification And Name
IDNA.definition: Identification of the security and the security name are not the same.

FTAX.name: Financial Instrument Tax Year
FTAX.definition: Financial instrument is not valid for the requested tax year.

INID.name: Insufficient Investor Data
INID.definition: Investor data is insufficient. Applicable when the mandated market practice is not followed.

INAC.name: Invalid Account Servicer
INAC.definition: Account servicer is not recognised or is invalid.

CASH.name: Invalid Cash Account
CASH.definition: Cash account is not recognised or invalid.

INPM.name: Invalid New Plan Manager
INPM.definition: New plan manager is not recognised or is invalid.

INNA.name: Invalid Nominee Account
INNA.definition: Nominee account is not recognised or is invalid.

SAFE.name: Investment Account
SAFE.definition: Investment account identification is not recognised or is invalid.

INUK.name: Investor Name Address Unknown
INUK.definition: Investor name and address is not recognised.

NSLA.name: Not Compliant With SLA
NSLA.definition: Instruction is not compliant with the service level agreement.

SECU.name: Not Enough Financial Instrument
SECU.definition: There are not enough securities in the account to process the instruction.

PTNS.name: Partial Not Supported
PTNS.definition: Partial transfer is not supported. Applicable when tax years are rolled up and because, for example, a transfer request for tax year 2000 only is received, it is not possible to process the transfer as the investor holds other tax years as well.

DLVY.name: Physical Delivery Impossible
DLVY.definition: Order contains physical delivery details but the fund can not be physically delivered.

DDAT.name: Settlement Date
DDAT.definition: Cash settlement date is not recognised or is invalid.

ISTP.name: Settlement Parties
ISTP.definition: One or several settlement parties are not recognised or are invalid.

DEPT.name: Settlement Place
DEPT.definition: Place of settlement is not recognised or is invalid.

ISAT.name: Invalid ISA Type
ISAT.definition: ISA type is not recognised or invalid.

OTHR.name: Other
OTHR.definition: Another reason for the status rejected.

NCON.name: Not Convertable
NCON.definition: The two share classes are not part of the same fund.

ACLO.name: Asset Closed
ACLO.definition: Asset instructed for transfer is closed.

BLTR.name: Account Blocked For Transfer
BLTR.definition: Investment account is blocked due to a transfer out of investment funds.

COSE.name: Already Executed
COSE.definition: Order or transfer has already been executed and confirmation has been sent.

BMRV.name: Below Minimum Retained Amount
BMRV.definition: Holding will be below the minimum retained value.

DINV.name: Data Invalid
DINV.definition: Data in the order or transfer instruction is invalid.

ICAG.name: Delivering Agent
ICAG.definition: Delivering agent is not recognised or is invalid.

IPAC.name: Instructing Party Not Allowed For Account
IPAC.definition: Instructing party is not allowed to instruct for this investment account.

INTE.name: Intermediary
INTE.definition: Intermediary is not recognised or is invalid.

PRCT.name: Percentage Holding Breach
PRCT.definition: Percentage holding breach, for example, PPM rules; taxation rules (ERISA).

IVAG.name: Receiving Agent
IVAG.definition: Receiving agent is not recognised or is invalid.

NCRR.name: Settlement Amount Currency
NCRR.definition: Unrecognised or invalid Settlement Amount Currency.

DTRD.name: Trade Date
DTRD.definition: Unrecognised or invalid trade date or requested trade date or future trade date.

UPAY.name: Unaccepted Payment Method
UPAY.definition: Payment method, for example, cheque or payment card, is not accepted.

URSC.name: Unaccepted Requested Settlement Currency
URSC.definition: Settlement currency requested is not supported.
